name: Ascentek
old_description: Ascentek is your partner for cutting-edge solutions that streamline operations, tackle the toughest challenges and push forward into the future. We aren't waiting for the path to be paved, we're here to make tomorrow a little bit better than today.
about:
Ascentek is headquartered in Shreveport, Louisiana, with an additional site in Golden Valley, Minnesota. The company is led by President and CEO Chad Baker, who was named an EY Entrepreneur Of The Year finalist in 2026. A founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company operates as a private-label fluid manufacturer and provides a suite of industrial services including bulk fluid distribution, vehicle wash equipment and service, hard parts assembly, onsite plant maintenance, chemical management programs, environmental services, drop-shipping, and software solutions. Its Maintenance 360® reliability services focus on keeping fluids and equipment running optimally in manufacturing environments. In 2025 Ascentek announced a $50 million expansion in Shreveport to support global growth and opened a Minnesota-based Battery Management Center for next-generation battery research. The company has earned a Great Place to Work Certification for four consecutive years.

Ascentek serves global OEMs and manufacturers across powersports, heavy-duty, marine, industrial, outdoor power equipment, automotive, vehicle wash, and specialty markets. Customers include manufacturers seeking customized fluid formulations, chemical management, and equipment maintenance programs.

The company states that its purpose is to "make tomorrow a little bit better than today" and emphasizes community involvement through volunteer efforts and contributions. Its private-label solutions leverage in-house product design, development, and testing capabilities to maximize equipment performance and life expectancy.
